children: Overview
France management consulting and digital services firm's H1 2026 revenue grew 7.2% yr/yr
Operating income and net profit both rose double digits compared to prior year
Company completed EUR 17.1 mln share repurchase and paid EUR 33.4 mln dividend
Outlook
NEURONES reaffirms full-year revenue guidance exceeding €900 mln
Company expects full-year operating income of approximately 9%
Result Drivers
ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said H1 2026 revenue growth of 7.2% included 6.9% organic growth, accelerating from prior year
IMPROVED PROFITABILITY - Operating income rose 19.9% and net income grew 16.4% yr/yr, with higher profitability ratios cited

The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
